rationale: Although LINE is in a strong post-earnings downtrend trading below both VWAP ($35.41) and its 5-minute 9-EMA ($35.16), the last five 1-minute candles represent a straight drop from $34.95 to $34.51 without any consolidation. Additionally, the portfolio already holds substantial short exposure across five positions.
